messages:
jessica: Raj from Meridian just asked for DPA + SCCs and a short DSAR/deletion SLA before the POC. they also want a short proof-of-deletion artifact after account close. deadline: Thurs COB.

raj: hi team — procurement needs: 30-day deletion SLA, confirmation no customer content used for training, subprocessors list, and a deletion certificate / export bundle example. can you confirm?

mike: we can do 30 days for active data. export endpoint exists. deletion triggers S3 delete + KV purge. we'll also provide a signed deletion certificate (simple timestamped manifest) for the POC.

sara: i'll attach subprocessors and a one-page security attestation (TLS1.2+, AES-256, KMS, RBAC via SSO, SOC2). also note: we can offer EU region hosting for data residency during the POC.

amy-legal: legal agrees to a no-training clause for POC: "Redwood will not use Customer Data to train models during the POC or after, without explicit written consent." we'll sign the SCC addendum scoped to the POC.

jessica: mike — can you draft the export curl + a minimal deletion-certificate example we can share?

mike: export example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/export -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"user_id":"u-789"}'`

mike: deletion cert example (manifest): `{"user_id":"u-789","deleted_at":"2025-09-15T14:32:00Z","objects_removed":123}`. we'll sign that with our key and attach PDF.

sara: CAIQ/SIG subset — we'll only answer infra and data lifecycle controls for the POC scope to speed review. mark other org-level items as "out of scope for POC".

raj: that's helpful. one more ask: can you confirm audit log retention for deletions? procurement wants proof we keep a tamper-evident audit trail for 90 days.

mike: yes — delete audit entries retained 90 days, write-once logs, access limited to infra oncall.

amy-legal: i'll prep the DPA paragraph and SCC addendum in the shared doc. please include the EU hosting note.

sec-bot: shared doc created at /shared/poc-meridian/1799990005 by jessica

jessica: ok team — i'll bundle DPA + SCC addendum + CAIQ subset + attestation + export/delete examples + deletion cert and send to Raj Thur 09:00. flag me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
